reasons.why: Code is 79% of characters and python alone has 3431732 of the 4937063 lines. History is 88% of items but only 12% of characters, and prose is 6% of characters. No other data type comes close to code, so the code strategy (the default graph) fits. No custom strategy is justified: there are no tune questions, so nothing shows a built-in losing to a configuration I could write down.

I am keeping every setting at its default. This set has no tune questions, so I have no hit@5 to support changing bm25_name, bm25_path, bm25_body or semantic_weight. Build keys and semantic_mode stay as they are. There are no vectors in this graph, and only 10093 passages sit over 1027 nodes. No entities step: prose is only 6% of characters, and the sensitive labels (email in 15680 items, phone in 10527 items) argue against sending text to a model. I re-measure with tune questions once the set has some.
